scope: observed command catalogue, not capability or creative acceptance

commands.label: Create Text
commands.params: {x, y, text, size?: pt, font?: family, style?, color?, area?: {width, height}} → {id}

commands.label: Create Outlines
commands.params: {} convert the selected text to groups of compound paths (one per glyph) → {ids}

commands.label: Set Text
commands.params: {id?|ids?, text} replace the contents of text objects (keeps the first run's style)

commands.label: Area Type Options…
commands.params: {ids?, rows?, columns?, gutter?: pt, inset?: pt, firstBaseline?: ascent|capHeight|xHeight|leading|fixed, firstBaselineMin?: pt} set the selected area type's options (none given: query) → the first object's options

commands.label: Fit Headline
commands.params: {ids?} track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width → {tracking}

commands.label: Character
commands.params: {ids?|id?, font?, style?, size?: pt, leading?: pt|"auto", tracking?: 1/1000 em, justify?: "left"|"center"|"right"|"justifyAll", fill?: colour, features?: ["dlig", "-liga", …] OpenType}

commands.label: Change Case
commands.params: {case: "upper"|"lower"|"title"|"sentence", ids?} → {ids}

commands.label: Smart Punctuation…
commands.params: {quotes?: true (straight quotes become the Document Setup quotes), dashes?: true (-- → en dash, --- → em dash), ellipsis?: true (... → …), scope?: "selection"|"document"} → {changed}

commands.label: Convert To Area Type
commands.params: {ids?} point type → area type framed by its current layout bounds → {ids}

commands.label: Convert To Point Type
commands.params: {ids?} area type → point type; soft line wraps become line breaks → {ids}

commands.label: Type on a Path Options…
commands.params: {start?: 0..1 (fraction of the path length), flip?: bool (reverse the path), effect?: rainbow|skew|3dRibbon|stairStep|gravity, ids?}

commands.label: Fill with Placeholder Text
commands.params: {ids?} replace selected text with placeholder text (area type is filled to its frame) → {ids}

commands.label: Insert Character
commands.params: {char: "bullet"|"copyright"|"ellipsis"|"paragraph"|"registered"|"section"|"trademark"|"emDash"|"enDash"|"discretionaryHyphen"|"nonBreakingHyphen"|"doubleLeftQuote"|"doubleRightQuote"|"singleLeftQuote"|"singleRightQuote"|"emSpace"|"enSpace"|"hairSpace"|"sixthSpace"|"thinSpace"|"nonBreakingSpace"|"figureSpace"|"punctuationSpace"|"thirdSpace"|"quarterSpace"|"tab"|"forcedLineBreak"|"paragraphReturn" | text: string} append to the selected text objects

commands.label: Edit Text
commands.params: {id, start: byte, end: byte, insert?: string, runs?: [{text, style}]} replace bytes start..end of the plain text (inserted text takes the replaced text's style unless styled `runs` are given) → {id, caret}

commands.label: Character
commands.params: {id, start?: byte, end?: byte (default: all text), font?, style?, size?: pt, leading?: pt|"auto", tracking?, kerning?: 1/1000 em|"auto", baselineShift?: pt, hScale?: %, vScale?: %, rotation?: deg, fill?: colour|"none", stroke?: colour|"none", strokeWidth?: pt, strokeOptions?: {weight?, cap?, join?, miterLimit?, dash?, dashOffset?, alignDashes?} (as stroke.set: the character stroke), underline?, strikethrough?, allCaps?: bool, smallCaps?: bool, position?: "normal"|"superscript"|"subscript" (sizes from Document Setup), features?: ["dlig", "-liga", …]} style a character range (runs are split at the range ends) → {id, runs}

commands.label: Get Text Range
commands.params: {id, start?, end?} → {text, runs: [{text, style}], length}

commands.label: Area / Path Type
commands.params: {path: id, mode: "area"|"onPath", text?: "", at?: [x, y] (on-path start: nearest point), size?, font?} turn a path into an area-type frame or a type-on-a-path baseline (the path's paint is dropped) → {id}

commands.label: Fit Headline
commands.params: {ids?} track the first line of area type so it fills the frame width → {ids, tracking}

commands.label: Character Styles
commands.params: {} → {styles: [{name, attrs, uses}]}

commands.label: New Character Style
commands.params: {name?, attrs?: {…}} (default attrs: the selected text's) → {name}

commands.label: Apply Character Style
commands.params: {name, clearOverrides?, ids?|id + start?/end? (a Type tool range)} → {count}

commands.label: Redefine Character Style
commands.params: {name, id?, start?} from the selected text; users keep their overrides

commands.label: Character Style Options
commands.params: {name, attrs: {…}} replace the style's attributes; users keep their overrides

commands.label: Duplicate Character Style
commands.params: {name} → {name}

commands.label: Rename Character Style
commands.params: {name, to}

commands.label: Delete Character Style
commands.params: {name} (text keeps its look)

commands.label: Paragraph Styles
commands.params: {} → {styles: [{name, attrs, uses}]}

commands.label: New Paragraph Style
commands.params: {name?, attrs?: {…}} (default attrs: the selected text's) → {name}

commands.label: Apply Paragraph Style
commands.params: {name, clearOverrides?, ids?|id + start?/end? (a Type tool range)} → {count}

commands.label: Redefine Paragraph Style
commands.params: {name, id?, start?} from the selected text; users keep their overrides

commands.label: Paragraph Style Options
commands.params: {name, attrs: {…}} replace the style's attributes; users keep their overrides

commands.label: Duplicate Paragraph Style
commands.params: {name} → {name}

commands.label: Rename Paragraph Style
commands.params: {name, to}

commands.label: Delete Paragraph Style
commands.params: {name} (text keeps its look)

commands.label: Fonts in Document
commands.params: {selectionOnly?} → [{family, style, runs, objects, missing}] sorted by name

commands.label: Replace Font
commands.params: {from: {family, style?}, to: {family, style?}, selectionOnly?} (style omitted: every style of the family / keep the closest style) → {runs}

commands.label: Create
commands.params: {} thread the selected area type (and closed paths, which become frames) in stacking order → {ids}

commands.label: Release Selection
commands.params: {} take the selected frames out of their threads (the story re-flows through the rest)

commands.label: Remove Threading
commands.params: {} break the selected frames' threads; each frame keeps the text it shows

commands.label: Threads
commands.params: {} → [[id…]] every thread in order

commands.label: Set Tab Stops
commands.params: {stops: [{position: pt, align?: left|center|right|decimal, leader?: ". ", alignOn?: "."}], ids?} replace the tab stops of the selected text

commands.label: Tab Stops
commands.params: {ids?} → {stops} of the first selected text object

commands.label: Clear All Tabs
commands.params: {ids?}

commands.label: Character / Paragraph
commands.params: {ids?|id?, kerning?: 1/1000 em|"auto", baselineShift?: pt, hScale?: %, vScale?: %, rotation?: deg, underline?, strikethrough?, allCaps?, smallCaps?: bool, position?: "normal"|"superscript"|"subscript" (sizes from Document Setup), leftIndent?, rightIndent?, firstLineIndent?, spaceBefore?, spaceAfter?: pt, hyphenate?: bool}
